name: inspira-marquee
title: Marquee
blurb: Children scroll continuously in a loop, horizontally or vertically.
description: Repeats children N times and animates them in a seamless marquee effect. Supports reverse direction, pause-on-hover, and both horizontal and vertical layouts. Inline CSS keyframes define the animation.
use_when: Displaying rows of reviews, testimonials, logos, or any content that benefits from continuous scrolling emphasis.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users—animation is always running without prefers-reduced-motion support.
a11y: Children are rendered as-is; no ARIA for the loop. Pause on hover helps keyboard users. No keyboard controls to navigate.
